# django-nx

> A lightweight, opinionated set of Django model fields, model/queryset helpers,
> and Django REST Framework extensions. Current project version: 0.7.0.

The recommended import is `import nx`. Public APIs are explicitly exported by
`nx.__all__`; DRF APIs are under `nx.drf`. The installed distribution includes
the version-matched AI API contract at `nx/ai_context.md`.

## Documentation

- [AI API context](https://github.com/JoshYuJump/django-nx/blob/main/nx/ai_context.md): concise public API, defaults, examples, and compatibility
- [README](https://github.com/JoshYuJump/django-nx/blob/main/README.md): human-oriented guide and examples
- [AI project setup](https://github.com/JoshYuJump/django-nx/blob/main/docs/ai-project-setup.md): AGENTS.md, Claude Code, and Cursor templates
- [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/django-nx/): releases and installation metadata

## Source of truth

For a project with django-nx installed, prefer the bundled `nx/ai_context.md`
because it matches the installed package version. Use online documentation only
when the installed contract is unavailable.
